intro.text: A lighteyed commander in Meridas Amaram's army.

items.text: In a battle against Hallaw's forces, Sheler ordered his outnumbered soldiers to hold a hilltop despite heavy losses. One of his squadleaders, Varth, sacrificed several messenger boys, Tien among them, as a distraction.

On the Herdazian border, Sheler used the singer invasion as an excuse to rob and murder civilians and abuse women. Captured by the Mink, he was refused ransom and given a choice of punishments. He chose to wrestle 'the hog', which turned out to be a huge clawed sea creature, and did not survive.

appearance.text: Sheler is a lighteyes of the fifth dahn.

personality.text: Sheler is arrogant and self-righteous, even as a prisoner.
